title: Fewest Cuts for Palindrome Pieces
summary: Cut a string into palindromes using as few cuts as possible.
statement: Return the minimum number of cuts needed to split `s` so that every piece is a palindrome.
hints: If you know the fewest cuts for every prefix, can you extend to a longer prefix?
cuts[i] = min over palindromic `s[j..i]` of cuts[j-1] + 1 (or 0 if j == 0). Precompute which substrings are palindromes.

pal[j][i] = s[j] == s[i] and (i - j < 2 or pal[j+1][i-1])
for i in range(n):
    cuts[i] = min(0 if j == 0 else cuts[j-1] + 1 for j with pal[j][i])
return cuts[n-1]
O(n^2) time and space. Expanding around centers can fill the cuts array without the n×n table.
